Acoustic_Brass_Trumpet_Ears.description: Crafted from polished brass, these intricate mechanical ears are affixed to the cephalon of a construct, amplifying their hearing range and sensitivity to grant heightened perception and the ability to detect even the faintest sounds, enhancing their vigilance and alertness.

Crystal_Resonance_Receptors.description: Embedded within the crystalline exoskeleton of the construct's head, these resonant receptors hum with arcane energy, enhancing the entity's wisdom and perception while granting it the supernatural ability to perceive its surroundings without relying on light or sound.

Steam_Whistle_Exhaust_Ears.description: These mechanical ears, crafted from gleaming brass and intricately designed to mimic the appearance of a steam-powered whistle, emit a constant low hum and occasional sharp blast, causing others to perceive the wearer as both imposing and slightly unsettling, while also granting a subtle charm that manipulates social interactions.

Radar_Dish_Mechanical_Ears.description: The Radar_Dish_Mechanical_Ears is a sleek, metallic appendage fused to the skull, humming with arcane energy and granting its bearer an unparalleled auditory range and sharp awareness, enhancing their perception of the world around them and allowing them to pinpoint the exact location of any sound-emitting creature or object within a vast radius.

Stone_Carved_Gargoyle_Ears.description: The Stone-Carved Gargoyle Ears, crafted from ancient stone and fused with the essence of a gargoyle, enhance the wearer's natural armor and perception, allowing them to blend into stone environments and block incoming attacks with ease.

Porcelain_Painted_Doll_Ears.description: These delicate, ceramic ears are painted in intricate patterns that seem to shift and change with the wearer's emotions, enhancing their charisma and subtly improving their perception, allowing them to notice the subtle cues that others miss.

Scrap_Metal_Funnel_Ears.description: The Scrap Metal Funnel Ears are jagged, rusted appendages that jut out like twisted antennae from the construct's head, enhancing its acute perception of the surroundings while giving it an unsettling, mechanical visage that strikes fear into the hearts of those who behold it.

Wood_Grain_Sound_Chambers.description: Embedded deep within the cephalon of this ancient construct, intricate wood grain sound chambers amplify the subtlest of auditory cues, enhancing both perception and wisdom as the entity becomes acutely attuned to its surroundings, its senses guided by an innate botanical intuition.

Stitched_Leather_Flap_Ears.description: These jagged, stitched leather flaps, barely resembling natural ears, protrude from the construct's head, granting it an eerie, heightened awareness at the cost of its semblance of humanity and charisma.

Mithril_Filigree_Receptor_Ears.description: Crafted from the rare and resilient metal mithril, these intricate filigree receptor ears are a testament to the arcane and mechanical ingenuity of the eldritch forges. With each delicate curve and spiral finely attuned to the whispers of magic and the subtle cues of the environment, they enhance the wearer's perception and charisma, making them a paragon of vigilance and charm in the shadowed realms.
